verses: I also saw the soul of a man who stood up, in hell, in the form of a serpent like a column; and his head was like unto a human head, and the remaining body, unto a serpent.
And I asked thus: 'What sin was committed by this body?'
Srosh the pious, and Adar the angel, said thus: 'This is the soul of that wicked man who, in the world, committed apostacy; and he fled into hell, in the form of a serpent.'
